items.question: How do I quickly identify qualified leads in huge comment volumes?
items.answer: Set intent keyword templates and run filtering on scraped comments. This helps isolate users with explicit purchase or inquiry signals first.

items.question: Do I need to pay to export Douyin lead lists?
items.answer: Core export is free. You can download lead data to Excel/CSV and hand it to sales teams immediately.

items.question: Will the tool miss abbreviated contact wording or slang?
items.answer: No, as long as text is visible on page. Add common slang variants to your keyword template to improve recall for your niche.

items.question: Why are profile links and IP location important in lead files?
items.answer: Profile links are stable identifiers for accurate revisit. IP location helps local-service teams prioritize nearby prospects with higher conversion probability.

items.question: How do teams manage lead follow-up after export?
items.answer: Sync leads into Lark Base, assign owners, tag stages, and record outreach notes so everyone tracks progress in one workflow.

items.question: How many comments should I process per viral video?
items.answer: Starting with the latest or most-engaged 200-500 comments often captures the strongest intent signals while keeping operations efficient.
